# Task register reference

<!-- Generated by research/build_reference_docs.py; do not edit by hand. -->

This is the task register reference for the open emitters, **not** a vendor ISA
specification.  It documents the values `open_rknpu.register_profile.REGISTERS` makes a
task write: which register word, the profile default, and the engine tag.  Each row is
one entry of that table, in table order (the table lists `0x1040` twice), and the
meaning column is filled only where the investigation recovered it - an undecoded
field says so rather than inventing a vendor name.

How to read a row.  A command word is a 64-bit little-endian value laid out as
`tag << 48 | value << 16 | reg`; the address column is the low 16 bits (`reg`), the
default column is the 32-bit value word, and the tag column is the top 16 bits.  The
tag distinguishes the class of write: the profile rows carry the per-engine tags
`0x0201` (CNA), `0x0801` (DPU), `0x1001` (DPU/EW), `0x2001` (EW) and `0x0401` (pool),
while the task tail ends with `0x0101` register words (link at `0x10`, control at
`0x14`), a `0x0041` zero task descriptor and the `0x0081` enable word.  Addresses are
arena offsets.  A register the emitters do not override keeps its profile default.

The meanings come from the comments in `src/open_rknpu/register_profile.py`, the
emitters' `fields` dicts, `runtime/sequence_format.md` and `docs/investigation-log.md`
(searched for the address in hex).  Where only a field expression identifies a
register, that expression is quoted; names such as `BS_OW_CFG`, `erdma_cfg` or
`ew_surf_stride` are RK3588/Mesa names the investigation re-checked on RV1103.

## CNA / conv geometry

| Address | Tag | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x100c` | `0x0201` | `0x2000a000` | CNA mode/config word; the single-input-channel profile writes 0x20008000, the depthwise second task writes 7. |
| `0x1010` | `0x0201` | `0x000003ff` | CNA feature grains (bits 7:4) and scan flags (bits 3:0), written as `(feature_grains<<4)\|scan_flags`; the K5 and transposed paths store 0x3ff. |
| `0x1014` | `0x0201` | `0x00000009` | CNA stride/dilation word: `(dy-1)<<21 \| (dx-1)<<16 \| sy<<3 \| sx`; the transposed emitters use `(stride-1)<<11 \| (stride-1)<<8 \| 9`. |
| `0x1020` | `0x0201` | `0x00080008` | CNA input geometry: `input_width<<16 \| task_input_rows`. |
| `0x1024` | `0x0201` | `0x00020010` | CNA channel geometry: `(input_channels-1)<<16 \| 16-lane_plane_count`. |
| `0x1028` | `0x0201` | `0x00000008` | CNA output width in pixels. |
| `0x102c` | `0x0201` | `0x00000040` | CNA output pixel count (`output_height*output_width`). |
| `0x1030` | `0x0201` | `0x00000010` | CNA weight-table bytes: `output_channels*lanes*k*k`; depthwise stores `k*k*32`. |
| `0x1034` | `0x0201` | `0x00000004` | CNA per-output weight stride: `lanes*k*k`; depthwise stores `k*k*16`. |
| `0x1038` | `0x0201` | `0x01010004` | CNA kernel and output channels: `k<<24 \| k<<16 \| output_channels`. |
| `0x103c` | `0x0201` | `0x00100000` | CNA weight data entries in the high half (`data_entries<<16`); depthwise stores `(width+1)//2<<16`. |
| `0x1044` | `0x0201` | `0x00100002` | CNA input width and data entries: `input_width<<16 \| data_entries`; depthwise stores `width<<16 \| (width+1)//2`. |
| `0x1048` | `0x0201` | `0x04000000` | CNA input surface extent term: `((input_rows*width*tiles+2047)//2048)*0x04000000`; the transposed paths store 0x1c000000. |
| `0x1068` | `0x0201` | `0x00000000` | CNA kernel phase field: `((k-1-pad_left)<<8) \| (k-1-pad_top)`; depthwise stores `pad*0x101`. |
| `0x107c` | `0x0201` | `0x00000018` | CNA input row/line stride: `input_width*min(4,(input_rows+3)//4*2)`. |
| `0x1080` | `0x0201` | `0x00000018` | CNA input surface row atoms: `((surface_rows*input_width+3)//4)*4`. |
| `0x1084` | `0x0201` | `0x00180001` | CNA input width and rows: `input_width<<16 \| input_rows`. |
| `0x1088` | `0x0201` | `0x00000010` | CNA active 16-lane plane count (`lanes`). |
| `0x1188` | `0x0201` | `0x00000002` | CNA weight-table stride: `8*k*k*tiles` (native), `8*k*k` (chain) or `k*k*8` (depthwise). |
| `0x118c` | `0x0201` | `0x000f000f` | CNA feature width minus one, duplicated: `(input_width-1)<<16 \| (input_width-1)`. |

## DPU / activation

| Address | Tag | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x3010` | `0x0801` | `0x00000001` | DPU task control word; depthwise writes 10, the K5 transposed phase path writes 0xa. |
| `0x3014` | `0x0801` | `0x00070007` | DPU output geometry: `(output_height-1)<<16 \| (output_width-1)`. |
| `0x3018` | `0x0801` | `0x0000000f` | DPU output 16-lane channel count minus one (`align(oc,16)-1`; depthwise writes 31). |
| `0x400c` | `0x1001` | `0x000001e4` | DPU/EW output-converter config word; 0x1e4 default, 0x1e5 for the elementwise/clamp tasks and 0x1fc for depthwise. |
| `0x4010` | `0x1001` | `0x00800000` | EW output control word; the LUT setup writes 0x804000. |
| `0x4018` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | Low output clamp of the appended Mul+Clip clamp task (`lo & 0xff`). |
| `0x401c` | `0x1001` | `0x7fffffff` | High output clamp of the Mul+Clip clamp task (`(hi+128)&0xff`); 0x7fffffff when unused. |
| `0x4024` | `0x1001` | `0x00000400` | Output plane surface stride in bytes. |
| `0x4028` | `0x1001` | `0x7fffffff` | Upper accumulator clamp for the fused Clip[0,6] (`round(6/(max_weight_scale*input_scale))`). |
| `0x4030` | `0x1001` | `0x00000007` | Output width minus one. |
| `0x4034` | `0x1001` | `0x00000007` | Output height minus one. |
| `0x403c` | `0x1001` | `0x0003000f` | Output channel pair: `(output_channels-1)<<16 \| (aligned_lanes-1)` (15 or 31). |
| `0x4040` | `0x1001` | `0x00121d80` | DPU ALU/shift config; LeakyRelu and PRelu clear its 0x1c00 ALU-selector bits, the scalar-Mul path writes 0x120050. |
| `0x4044` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | Negated zero point of the second Mul operand, used with the 0x120050 ALU selector. |
| `0x4048` | `0x1001` | `0x00000001` | EW control bit set by the Mul path (default 1). |
| `0x4050` | `0x1001` | `0x30000001` | `BS_OW_CFG` (RK3588 name): bit 0 `OW_SRC`, bit 1 `OD_BYPASS`; measured on RV1103 - `OW_SRC=1` hangs and `OD_BYPASS=1` skips the per-channel block. |
| `0x4058` | `0x1001` | `0x00000003` | Output channel block count: `((oc-1)//16)<<16 \| 3` (native) or 3/7. |
| `0x405c` | `0x1001` | `0x00070007` | Output geometry pair: `(output_height-1)<<16 \| (output_width-1)`. |
| `0x4060` | `0x1001` | `0x00000013` | Activation selector: 0x13 off, 0x12 fused Relu, 0x22 LeakyRelu/PRelu. |
| `0x4068` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | Activation multiplier: LeakyRelu stores `round(alpha*16384)<<16`; PRelu stores 1 and reads its per-channel slopes from 0x502c. |
| `0x406c` | `0x1001` | `0x80000000` | Activation lower clamp: 0x80000000 when the activation is off, 0 when Relu is applied. |
| `0x4070` | `0x1001` | `0x010041c1` | `DPU_EW_CFG`: EW ALU selector at bit 16 (2 = Add, 0 = Max) plus the observed mode bits; names from Mesa Rocket/RK3588, re-checked on RV1103. |
| `0x4074` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | Negated zero point of the chained Mul operand. |
| `0x4078` | `0x1001` | `0x00000001` | EW operand scale: 0x4000 default, 0xc000 signed for Sub, 1 for the scalar-Mul path. |
| `0x407c` | `0x1001` | `0x80000000` | EW lower output clamp; the Mul-to-Relu path forces 0. |
| `0x40c0` | `0x1001` | `0x00000400` | Second output surface stride (the EW/DPU write surface). |
| `0x40d8` | `0x1001` | `0x80000000` | Lower output clamp bound for the Mul+Clip clamp task; 0x80000000 when unused. |
| `0x40dc` | `0x1001` | `0x7fffffff` | Upper output clamp bound for the Mul+Clip clamp task (`hi+128`); 0x7fffffff when unused. |
| `0x40e0` | `0x1001` | `0x80000000` | Second activation lower clamp, mirroring 0x406c. |
| `0x40e4` | `0x1001` | `0x7fffffff` | Second upper accumulator clamp for Clip[0,6], mirroring 0x4028. |
| `0x40e8` | `0x1001` | `0x80000000` | Second output lower clamp; the Mul-to-Relu path forces 0. |
| `0x4100` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup table base/width word (`0x20000 + table*0x10000`). |
| `0x4104` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup table entry: one register word per lookup-table value. |
| `0x4108` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup control word (1 in the setup skeleton, 0x68 on the activation path). |
| `0x410c` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup word 0x50500. |
| `0x4110` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup word 0xffffc000. |
| `0x411c` | `0x1001` | `0x00000000` | LUT setup word 0x4000. |
| `0x500c` | `0x2001` | `0x00000007` | EW output width minus one. |
| `0x5010` | `0x2001` | `0x00000007` | EW output height minus one; bits 28:16 carry `ew_line_notch_addr` (RK3588 name). |
| `0x5014` | `0x2001` | `0x0000000f` | EW output 16-lane channel count minus one (15 or 31). |
| `0x5028` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | Activation coefficient-table size (8 for PRelu). |
| `0x502c` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | Activation coefficient-table address (the PRelu per-channel slopes). |
| `0x5034` | `0x2001` | `0x00000001` | `erdma_cfg`: `data_mode` bits 31:30, `surf_mode` bit 29, `data_size` bits 3:2, `erdma_disable` bit 0; decoded from the RK3588 TRM (`data_mode=2` hangs). |
| `0x5040` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | `ew_surf_stride`: stride in 16-byte atoms (16 = one atom per channel, 0x240 = 36 atoms per pixel). |
| `0x5044` | `0x2001` | `0x00007810` | EW control word (0x7810/0x7816/0x907809 across the emitter paths). |
| `0x506c` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | `ew_surf_notch`: pixels from the end of this feature map to the end of the shape feature map; setting it stops the compact-operand timeouts. |

## Addresses

| Address | Tag | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x1070` | `0x0201` | `0x00002000` | CNA input base address: the arena offset of the surface the task reads. |
| `0x1110` | `0x0201` | `0x00000ac0` | CNA weight-table base address (arena offset). |
| `0x4020` | `0x1001` | `0x00003000` | Output base address: the arena offset the task writes. |
| `0x5018` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | EW primary surface address (the accumulator-side read). |
| `0x5020` | `0x2001` | `0x00000b00` | EW secondary operand base address (`RDMA_BS_BASE_ADDR`); a Conv bias block also lives here. |
| `0x5038` | `0x2001` | `0x00000000` | EW secondary surface address (the ERDMA read side / second branch). |

## Quantization

| Address | Tag | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x1184` | `0x0201` | `0x0000ff80` | Input zero point declared to the CNA (`input_zero_point-128`); it also sets the value the engine pads borders with. |
| `0x4080` | `0x1001` | `0xffffff80` | Output zero point, written by the Conv/EW quantization. |
| `0x4084` | `0x1001` | `0x00004040` | Output multiplier (the Q14/Q15 conversion factor). |
| `0x4088` | `0x1001` | `0x00000016` | Output conversion shift. |

## Tail / control

| Address | Tag | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0x1004` | `0x0201` | `0x0000000e` | CNA engine control word; the LUT setup raises it to 0x30. |
| `0x3004` | `0x0801` | `0x0000000e` | DPU engine control word; the LUT setup raises it to 0x30. |
| `0x4004` | `0x1001` | `0x0000000e` | DPU/EW engine control word; the LUT setup raises it to 0x30. |
| `0x5004` | `0x2001` | `0x0000000e` | EW engine control word; the LUT setup raises it to 0x30. |
